pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Sub-polygonal to rounded dark-tan regions with soft edge gradients; spatial distribution on the mid-flank shows moderate density with more irregular, elongated shapes appearing on the lower neck and chest transitions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream-colored negative space; junction nodes typically connect three to four patches; path thickness is relatively consistent with slight expansion at intersection nodes.
